description: How the world's largest urban agglomerations rewired global power: Tokyo's plateau and decline, Delhi and Lagos' explosive rise — 1990 to 2026 (UN-based urban agglomeration estimates & projections).
youtube_description: The world is reshuffling — not by GDP, but by sheer people power. This visualization traces UN-based urban agglomeration estimates and short-term projections (1990–2026) to show how Tokyo's long reign is flattening while Delhi and Lagos rocket upward. Watch the overtakes, the plateaus, and the explosive runs that rewrite global influence and infrastructure demand. Sources: United Nations World Urbanization data and national urban agglomeration estimates (medium variant projections for 2024–2026). If you want more data visualizations like this, subscribe, like, and tell us which city we should race next. Join the conversation below — what happens when mega-cities shift continents? #megacityboom #urbanization #populationrace #delhi #lagos
